description: Co-located evaluation benchmark for agent-orchestrator skill

test_cases.name: Multi-Phase Lifecycle Orchestration
test_cases.description: Ensures orchestrator coordinates specialist handovers in order without bypassing spec or TDD phases.
test_cases.prompt: Orchestrate the end-to-end development of a real-time presence awareness feature.

test_cases.name: Claim Linear ticket on main
test_cases.description: When playing a Linear issue, orchestrator claims In Progress, assigns the host agent, stays on main uncommitted, and outputs a conventional commit subject with the ticket id.
test_cases.prompt: Work WAY-123: implement the handshake align pointers on main.

test_cases.name: PostHog intake uses existing roles
test_cases.description: When turning PostHog signals into confirmed Linear work, orchestrator points at product-signal-intake and existing stories/PRD roles instead of a product-insights skill.
test_cases.prompt: Orchestrate filing PostHog backlog asks as Linear work through the lifecycle. Do not invent a specialist.

test_cases.name: Quality loops use existing roles
test_cases.description: When closing CI and telemetry quality loops through Linear, orchestrator points at quality-loops and existing debug/stories roles instead of a new specialist.
test_cases.prompt: Orchestrate quality loops so failed checks become Linear tickets a work picker can play. Do not invent a specialist.

test_cases.name: Scheduled scout files typed tickets without a PR
test_cases.description: When a scheduled scout files typed Linear tickets, orchestrator keeps one source, quality-loops, and no PR from that session.
test_cases.prompt: Orchestrate a scheduled scout for one source and file typed Linear tickets. Do not open a PR.

test_cases.name: Lighthouse drop files a Performance ticket without a PR
test_cases.description: When a Lighthouse category drops versus last main, orchestrator files Performance via quality-loops, does not chase 100, comments on a fingerprint, and does not open a PR.
test_cases.prompt: A Lighthouse category dropped versus last main. File a Performance ticket from the scout. Do not chase 100 or open a PR.
